events.headline: Russia launched an overnight missile and drone attack on Kyiv (10 missiles including 6 ballistic, plus 121 drones), injuring at least 10 people including a child and damaging residential buildings across three districts, underscoring continued escalation risk in the war

TSMC reported September revenue up ~39% y/y to NT$251.87bn, beating estimates on sustained AI-chip demand; Q3 sales of ~$30.8B beat consensus and the company raised 2026 capex guidance to $60-64B, reinforcing the AI/semiconductor demand narrative ahead of its Oct 8 monthly sales print

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reaffirmed that inflation is not decelerating toward the 2% target, with headline CPI near 3.4% y/y and core PCE near 3.7%; the Fed's Sept FOMC minutes are due for release today (Oct 7, 2pm ET) and prediction markets show roughly even odds between a hold and a hike at the Oct 27-28 meeting, keeping policy in a hawkish, data-dependent holding pattern
